messages:
Alex Chen: Hey payroll — my Feb 28 paystub shows NY state withholding but I updated residency to NH effective 2025-03-04. I submitted the relocation form in Rippling. Can we split the Mar payrun so NY withholding covers my days in NY only? Payroll id: PAYRUN-4589. Need confirmation this won't break W-2 at year-end. Thanks.

People Ops: Thanks Alex — we'll need proof of move (lease or utility) plus the relocation form. @Samir can you confirm the effective date we have on file?

Samir Patel: I can confirm the relocation form shows effective 2025-03-04. No lease uploaded yet. For payroll splits we usually prorate by days in the pay period. Which pay period covers Mar 1-15? Were you physically in NY on 2025-03-03?

Alex Chen: Yes last day physically in NY was 2025-03-03. The pay period is Mar 1–15. I'll attach the signed lease and landlord email in a sec.

People Ops: Please forward the lease to payroll@redwood.com and CC me. We'll open an adjustment request. @Payroll Bot will queue the job once docs received.

Payroll Bot: Payroll job queued: ADJUST-1912 for PAYRUN-4589. Est processing time: 2 business days. Confirm if you'd like the state withholding refunded on next check or as separate off-cycle adjustment.

Alex Chen: Refund on the next check preferred.

Maria Gomez: Got it. We'll process ADJUST-1912. Planned allocation for Mar 1–15 pay period: NY portion = Mar 1–3 (3 days), NH portion = Mar 4–15 (12 days). NY withholding will be recalculated on the NY portion only. NH has no state income tax. Payroll adjustment will show as 'State Allocation Correction' on your next paystub.

Maria Gomez: Quick note re: W-2 — payroll adjustments are used to reconcile year-to-date withholding. Typically we don't need a W-2C immediately; we'll reconcile and if the final annual withholdings change materially we'll issue a W-2C at year-end. If you prefer we can flag this for earlier review.

Alex Chen: Sounds good — please flag it so I'm in the loop.

People Ops: Will do. Once ADJUST-1912 completes we'll confirm amount and post a stub.

Payroll Bot: ADJUST-1912 completed. Adj record: ADJ-2025-04. NY withheld adjusted by $142.32. Next net pay reflects refund.

Alex Chen: Confirmed refund appeared on 2025-04-01 paystub. Line item: "State Allocation Correction — NY" for $142.32. Everything looks correct, thanks everyone! :thumbsup:

People Ops: Great — marking this resolved. If anything else pops up we'll reopen.
